description: SD-encoded form hook: when selective disclosure is in use, the derived identifier MUST be computed over the SD-encoded form, not the plaintext payload. The _sd array holds hashes of disclosed claims; _sd_alg names the hash algorithm.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-00 §4 ('When selective disclosure is in use, the derived identifier MUST be computed over the SD-encoded form of the payload, not the plaintext payload.')
note: The derived_id here differs from what would result from the plaintext payload. The canonical form for SD-encoded payloads includes _sd hashes and _sd_alg, which replace the original claim values. A profile MUST declare non-eligible for selective disclosure any field that the profile own verifier requires to evaluate the binding.
